references.text: Death penalty for anyone who disobeys the priest or the judge, a similar principle of punishing disobedience to authority.
Anyone who acts with a high hand and despises the word of the Lord shall be cut off. Rebellion against God's appointed leader is punished by death.
Prohibition against cursing a ruler among the people, showing the respect required toward leaders.
Saul refuses to kill those who opposed his kingship, but the principle of punishment for rebellion is acknowledged.
God's earlier encouragement to Joshua to be strong and courageous, which the people now repeat back to him.
The Lord's command to Joshua to be strong and courageous, the words the people now use to encourage their leader.
Moses' encouragement to Joshua to be strong and courageous, now repeated by the people of Israel.
The Lord himself commands Joshua to be strong and courageous, the same exhortation the people give to Joshua.
Exhortation to obey leaders and submit to them, reflecting the principle of obedience to God-given authorities.
